title: Northgate Care Protection Plans Enrollment Eligibility Card
content:
A Northgate Care Protection Plans contract is sold against one sale line, and each plan admits only the merchandise classes, product prices, purchase channels and purchase window shown on this card.

## Merchandise classes and product price range

| Plan | Merchandise classes the plan can be bought for | Lowest product price (USD) | Highest product price (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Care 2-Year Electronics Plan | televisions; computers and tablets; cameras and drones | 50.00 | 2999.99 |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan | televisions; computers and tablets; cameras and drones | 100.00 | 4999.99 |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan with Accident Protection | televisions; computers and tablets; cell phones; cameras and drones | 100.00 | 2999.99 |
| Northgate Care 4-Year Mattress & Furniture Plan | mattresses and furniture | 200.00 | 4999.99 |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Appliance Plan | major appliances | 200.00 | 4999.99 |
| Northgate Care 5-Year Appliance Plan | major appliances | 200.00 | 7999.99 |

## Purchase channels, purchase window and plans per sale line

| Plan | Purchase channels whose sale lines it can cover | Purchase window after the product's sale date | Plans per sale line |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Care 2-Year Electronics Plan | Northgate In-Club Purchase; Northgate Club Pickup Order; Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order | 30 calendar days | 1 |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan | Northgate In-Club Purchase; Northgate Club Pickup Order; Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order | 30 calendar days | 1 |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan with Accident Protection | Northgate In-Club Purchase; Northgate Club Pickup Order; Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order | 30 calendar days | 1 |
| Northgate Care 4-Year Mattress & Furniture Plan | Northgate In-Club Purchase; Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order; Northgate Special Order | 30 calendar days | 1 |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Appliance Plan | Northgate In-Club Purchase; Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order; Northgate Special Order | 30 calendar days | 1 |
| Northgate Care 5-Year Appliance Plan | Northgate In-Club Purchase; Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order; Northgate Special Order | 30 calendar days | 1 |

No Northgate Care plan lists Northgate Same-Day Delivery Order or Northgate Business Delivery Order among its purchase channels. The electronics plans list Northgate Club Pickup Order; the mattress, furniture and appliance plans list Northgate Special Order instead.

## Reading the card (hypothetical sale lines)

- A cell phone appears only in the merchandise classes of the Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan with Accident Protection.
- A hypothetical television sale line priced 4200.00 is above the highest product price of the Northgate Care 2-Year Electronics Plan (2999.99) and of the Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan with Accident Protection (2999.99), and within the range of the Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan (100.00 to 4999.99).
- A hypothetical refrigerator sale line priced 6500.00 is within the range of the Northgate Care 5-Year Appliance Plan (200.00 to 7999.99) and above that of the Northgate Care 3-Year Appliance Plan (4999.99).
- A hypothetical tablet sale line priced 75.00 is within the range of the Northgate Care 2-Year Electronics Plan only, since the other electronics plans start at 100.00.
